digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parsing and command dispatch
propositions: Eleven near-duplicate CLI verbs (exists, format, check-ac, clarity-check, quality-check, tag, untag, get-file-impact, get-verify-commands, list-descendants, session-logs) each own redundant routes, parsers, help artifacts, and exit-code rows.
Removed spellings must fail loudly with a replacement hint via _REMOVED_SPELLINGS registry populated with 11 new entries plus 5 historical aliases, all yielding exit code 2.

Golden-path verbs consolidate operations: resolve absorbs format via --display flag, check unifies three gate modes via mutually exclusive flags, show gains --field, deps gains --descendants, list gains --limit, edit absorbs tag/untag via --add-tag/--remove-tag.

resolve_cli signature changes from (argv, tracker) to (argv, tracker, repo_root) to host --display rendering; resolve route adapter flips to argv_tracker_root; three gate handlers (check_ac_cli, clarity_check_cli, quality_check_cli) keep current signatures and are called from new check_cli(argv, tracker, repo_root).
recent_session_logs_state drops private sort and reuses sort_states(logs, '-created')[:limit] for parity with list --type=session_log --sort=-created --limit=N across library, MCP, and CLI.

Every removed verb invocation in tests and scripts retargets to the new spelling; removed handler imports are deleted; the removed-spelling dispatch test is parametrized from _REMOVED_SPELLINGS with 16 rows covering all 11 + 5 aliases.
